payload.title: Inventory every human signal the home page could use
payload.description: Ryan's overall goal is to use all available human signals. Today: Accept and Reject, Reference stars, vote explanations, Messages on a Reference or Story, human relationship edges (explanations are first-class), concept steering. List what each could change on a home page and what must stay private, as a design note; build nothing beyond what Ryan picks. Stars and accepts ship first.
